d:
Good Morning Dosto!
Is video me hum lekar aaye hain Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor ke Package-08 ka latest ground report, jo Odisha–Andhra Pradesh border par ban raha hai.
Yeh hilly terrain me ban raha stretch project ka ek critical section hai, jaha par twin tunnel, long viaducts, major bridges, animal underpasses, slope protection aur cut-and-fill construction jaise kaam ho rahe hain.
Video Highlights:
Package-08 location & contractor details (Bekem Infra & Max Infra)
Odisha–Andhra border ke hilly terrain ka ground reality
Large box-type underpass & wildlife underpass updates
